messages.content: [2026 WNBA Finals feature record African representation as Golden State, Atlanta chase first title] History will be made when the 2026 WNBA Finals between the Golden State Valkyries and Atlanta Dream tips off this Saturday. For the first time in league history, the Finals will feature three players and one executive with African connections, the highest African representation in the championship series dating to the league's inaugural season in 1997. Ghanaian-American general manager Ohemaa Nyanin and Canadian forward Laeticia Amihere , whose parents are Ghanaian, represent Golden State, while on the other side, Atlanta have Mali international Sika Kone and Kenyan center Madina Okot . The four surpass the previous high of three from 2008, when players Olayinka Sanni (Detroit Shock) and Morenike Atunrase (San Antonio Silver Stars) were on opposing teams, with Mike Ekanem serving as strength and conditioning coach for San Antonio. All three are of Nigerian heritage, and Sanni even represented Nigeria, winning two silver medals and one bronze across three All Africa Games tournaments. This year's Finals, which begin Saturday in San Francisco, brings together two franchises seeking their first WNBA championship, with Nyanin's leadership of Golden State's basketball operations introducing an executive dimension to Africa's history in the league. Appointed the Valkyries' inaugural general manager in May 2024, Nyanin became the first executive of African origin in the WNBA, and has overseen one of the fastest rises by an expansion franchise in WNBA history. Under her leadership, Golden State became the first WNBA expansion team to qualify for the playoffs in their inaugural season in 2025 and followed that by reaching the Finals in only their second season, another expansion franchise record. messages.content: [One Piece (2023 TV series) season 2] The second season of the American fantasy adventure television series One Piece, marketed as Into the Grand Line, based on the manga of the same name written by Eiichiro Oda, was developed for television by Matt Owens and Joe Tracz. The season was produced by Kaji Productions and Shueisha. The season stars Iñaki Godoy, Emily Rudd, Mackenyu, Jacob Romero, Taz Skylar, Charithra Chandran, and Mikaela Hoover. In the season, Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates embark on their journey across the Grand Line while facing off against an organization of assassins called Baroque Works. The season released on the streaming service Netflix on March 10, 2026.
